items.title: File:Continental and oceanic crust.png
items.licence: cc0 cc0 creative commons zero, public domain dedication true
items.author: USGS and me. I made a better labeling.
items.review_note: Shows continental crust, oceanic crust and upper mantle as a block diagram rather than shelf-slope-rise anatomy. Useful but not the margin figure asked for; the margin anatomy reference remains the .webp already in Deep Time Maps and Resources.

items.query: age of oceanic lithosphere map NOAA
items.why: the crustal age pattern seafloor.py synthesises
items.title: File:2008 age of ocean plates.png
items.licence: public domain pd public domain false
items.author: Elliot Lim, CIRES & NOAA/NGDC
items.review_note: CORRECT and the single most useful fetch of either round: the NOAA/NGDC age-of-oceanic-crust map with a 0-280 Myr colour scale. Public domain (US federal). This is the pattern seafloor.py and crustage.py synthesise, and it is directly measurable against our _o field.

items.title: File:Carboniferous regional subdivisions.png
items.licence: cc0 cc0 creative commons zero, public domain dedication true
items.author: Kent G. Budge
items.review_note: NOT the ICS chart: a Carboniferous regional-stage correlation table (ICS vs Russian, W European, N American, Chinese usage). Genuinely useful for the Carboniferous, wrong for the slug.

items.why: the Suess/Wegener five-continent fossil distribution - THE Gondwana argument
items.title: File:Snider-Pellegrini Wegener fossil map-de.svg
items.licence: public domain pd public domain false
items.author: Osvaldocangaspadilla; Lumu (talk)
items.credit: File:Snider-Pellegrini Wegener fossil map.svg, verändert von Lumu (talk)
items.review_note: CORRECT: the classic Snider-Pellegrini/Wegener fossil-distribution map - Glossopteris (green), Lystrosaurus (brown), Mesosaurus (blue), Cynognathus (orange) across Africa, South America, India, Antarctica and Australia. Public domain. CAVEAT: the captions are in GERMAN; the taxon names are Latin so it still reads, but an English version should be sought before any use on a card.
items.note_format: Commons returned a rasterised PNG thumbnail for an SVG source; the fetcher now sniffs the magic number instead of trusting the source mime.

items.licence: cc by 4.0 cc-by-4.0 creative commons attribution 4.0 true
items.author: Peter A. Cawood, Priyadarshi Chowdhury, Jacob A. Mulder, Chris J. Hawkesworth, Fabio A. Capitanio, Prasanna M. Gunawardana, and Oliver Nebel
items.credit: Cawood, P. A.; Chowdhury, P.; Mulder, J.A.; Hawkesworth, C. J.; Capitanio, F. A.; Gunawardana, P. M.; Nebel, O. (2022) "Secular evolution of continents and the
items.review_note: NOT a mid-ocean ridge: it is a continental-lithosphere cross-section labelling craton, shield, platform, Archean/Proterozoic/Phanerozoic orogens, sub-continental lithospheric mantle, and passive vs convergent margins. Wrong for the query and EXCELLENT for the continental-crust dossier, so kept under a corrected name. CC-BY-4.0, so it needs credit if used.

items.why: reference reconstruction to audit our own frames against
items.title: File:Induan map.jpg
items.licence: cc by 4.0 cc-by-4.0 creative commons attribution 4.0 true
items.author: Hendrik Nowak, Christian Vérard, Evelyn Kustatscher
items.review_note: CORRECT and the best of the set: a Permian/Pangaea palaeogeographic map with a BIOME legend (tropical summerwet, subtropical, warm and cool temperate, cold temperate). Directly checkable against our own biome shader at 250-280 Ma.

items.why: the disputed configuration, for the Precambrian frames
items.title: File:רודיניה.png
items.licence: public domain pd public domain false
items.author: John Goodge
items.review_note: Subject CORRECT - a Rodinia reconstruction at 1.1 Ga with cratons and orogenic belts - but the labels are in HEBREW, which makes it reference-only. Public domain.

items.title: File:Sea level temp 140ky.gif
items.licence: public domain pd public domain false
items.review_note: NOT Phanerozoic: it is global climate history over ~800 kyr plus late Quaternary sea level to -140 m. Useful for the LGM lowstand, wrong for the first-order curve.

items.why: arc, back-arc and trench anatomy for the feature_art cross-sections
items.title: File:Cross section of mariana trench.jpg
items.licence: public domain pd public domain false
items.author: Original uploader was Dino at English Wikipedia.
items.credit: Transfered from English Wikipedia. Transfer was stated to be made by User:TCY.
items.review_note: CORRECT and good: Mariana arc cross-section (after Hussong & Fryer 1981) with back-arc spreading axis, fore-arc, trench, seismic velocities and old-vs-young oceanic crust labelled. Directly usable for the arc/back-arc feature_art figure.

items.why: the gather-disperse loop and its sea-level/climate consequences
items.title: File:Oxygen fluctuation.png
items.licence: public domain pd public domain false
items.review_note: NOT a supercontinent cycle diagram - it is a Phanerozoic atmospheric O2 curve. Wrong for its query, right for the oxygen-history slot, so kept under that name. Shows the ~30-35% Permo-Carboniferous peak.

reviewed: 2026-07-26, two rounds, visual contact sheet each time
review_summary: Two fetch rounds, 12 files kept after review. Round 1: 8 fetched, 1 dropped as an entirely wrong subject (a 1913 chromosome diagram matched on the word 'cycle'), 3 renamed. Round 2: 4 fetched, 1 renamed (a continental-lithosphere section returned for a mid-ocean-ridge query), 1 flagged for being labelled in Hebrew, 1 flagged for being labelled in German. FOUR slots remain empty purely because Commons rate-limited the runs (429) - that is NOT evidence the figure does not exist.
